enchantments.tooltip: Strength +11: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +11 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Immunity to Fear: The wearer of this item is immune to all fear effects.
Tendon Slice +9: On Hit: 6% chance to slow target's movement by 50% for 9 seconds.
Stunning +12: +12 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Stunning Blow and Stunning Fist attempts.
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
